test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 69

questions.question: The diagonals of a rhombus are 26 cm and 45 cm, respectively. The area of the rhombus (in cm2) is:

A 120 m long train overtakes a man moving at a speed of 10 km/h (in the same direction) in 36 seconds. How much time (in seconds) will it take this train to completely cross another 390 m long train, moving in the opposite direction at a speed of 86 km/h?3368
The average of the first 11 multiples of 18 is:
एक आदमी अपने मासिक वेतन का 50% (₹ में) किराए पर खर्च करता है। हर महीने वह परिवहन पर ₹591 और किराने पर ₹8,835 रुपये खर्च करता है और शेष ₹274 बचाता है। उसका मासिक वेतन (₹ में) ज्ञात कीजिए।

A group of people consists of men, women and children. 20% of them are men, 40% are women and the rest are children, and their average weights are 45 kg, 60 kg and 20 kg, respectively. The average weight of the group (in kg) is:
In a clearance sale of electronic items, an item whose marked price was ₹12,175 is sold for ₹11,201, and d% is the discount percentage on the item. The value of d is:

One-third of a journey is covered at a speed of 12 km/hr, the next one-third of the journey is covered at a speed of 59 km/hr and the remaining journey is covered at a speed of 61 km/hr. The average speed (in km/hr, rounded off to one decimal place) for the entire journey is:

A and B can complete a work in 16 days and 48 days, respectively. They started doing the work together but after 3 days, B had to leave, and A completed the remaining work alone. The remaining work was completed in _______ (days).
P and Q together can fill a cistern in 3 hours. If P alone can fill the cistern in 6 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill the cistern?
A trader marks his goods 44% above the cost price and allows a discount of 10% on the marked price. He gains x%. The value of x is:
The product of two numbers is 368, and their LCM is 92. Find their HCF.

One-third of a journey is covered at a speed of 91 km/hr, the next one-third of the journey is covered at a speed of 49 km/hr and the remaining journey is covered at a speed of 19 km/hr. The average speed (in km/hr, rounded off to one decimal place) for the entire journey is:
When the selling price of a television is ₹16,920, the shopkeeper incurs a loss of 6%. What should be the selling price (in ₹) of the television to gain 5%?

A started a business with a capital of ₹3,66,000. After 3 months, B joined him with a certain amount of capital. At the end of a year of A's starting the business, the profit was shared in the ratio 6 : 3. How much (in ₹) did B invest?
The simple interest on a principal amount (in ₹) is ₹725 for a period of 2 years at the rate of 5% per annum. The principal amount (in ₹) is:
A man receives ₹4,690 per month as salary. He saves 20% of his salary every month. His expenditure (in ₹) per month is:
In a test, B got 68 marks while A got 75 marks, out of 95 maximum marks. What percentage of A's marks was B's marks?(Round off your answer to the nearest integer).

In a library, the ratio of the number of story books to that of non-story books was 4 : 1 and total number of story books was 1236. When some more story books were bought, the ratio became 13 : 3. Find the number of story books bought.4400

A, B and C together can complete a certain work in 42 days. B and C together can complete the same work in 49 days. B is 75% more efficient than A. A, B and C work together for 31 days. B alone will complete the remaining work in:3864

1000 identical small spheres are cast from a sphere of radius 50 cm, with the total volume of the small spheres being equal to the volume of the larger sphere. The diameter (in cm) of each of the small spheres is:1848
